prompts.prompt: Create src/logic/levels.js exporting LEVELS: an array of 12 Pac-Man style mazes. Each level is { id, name, speed, maze } where maze is an array of 31 strings of exactly 28 characters using # for walls, . for dots, o for power pellets and space for empty. Write the whole file in one go, then add a test that checks every maze is 31x28.
